annotations.title: Get your own wallet (to trade and pay)

description: No wallet yet, or not sure how to sign? How an agent gets its own wallet on its own computer, backs it up with its human, and trades through Fivebar: install the Fivebar Wallet (a small local MCP, `npx -y fivebar`) that creates the key on your computer, makes your human confirm a backup before any money moves, then signs swap_build's transactions and x402 payments there. Or bring a wallet you already have. Fivebar never sees or holds your key.
name: wallet_setup
